title: Volumetric Surprise
description: A featherweight but oversized crate — foam packing peanuts padding out a huge box — should still be billed by its volume, not its low actual weight. Confirm the pricing engine charges for whichever is bigger.
successCondition: POST /api/booking/quote with a package where weightKg is small (e.g. 2) but lengthCm/widthCm/heightCm are large enough that (lengthCm*widthCm*heightCm)/5000 exceeds weightKg (e.g. 100x100x100) returns 200 with chargeableWeightKg equal to the computed volumetricWeightKg, not weightKg, and weightFeeCents equal to round(chargeableWeightKg * 120).
hints: The volumetric divisor is 5000 and the per-kg rate is 120 cents — both documented in docs/api/booking.md.
Pick dimensions where the volumetric calculation clearly and unambiguously exceeds the actual weight, so there's no rounding ambiguity about which value wins.
